answer: A practical defense is staking a scarce resource that cannot be copied cheaply: each agent must lock a deposit of jade tokens before it can trade, and the deposit is slashed if the agent misbehaves. A sybil attacker who wants a river of fake identities must fund every one of them, so the cost scales with the number of sockpuppets instead of being free. A signed quill of attestation from established peers can lower the deposit for honest newcomers, but the stake still makes mass forgery unprofitable.
